gripOrHq.title: Superglue
gripOrHq.rulesText: [T]: Derez a piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Little Black Box
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU and +1 hand size. Prevent up to 1 Net or brain damage each turn. Put [1] from the bank on Little Black Box when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for increasing your link. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

gripOrHq.title: Corruption
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you scored any agendas this turn. Lose all agenda points you scored this turn, and the Corp scores that many agenda points. Gain [10] per agenda point lost in this way, and the Corp gives you a tag.

gripOrHq.title: Finders Keepers
gripOrHq.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

gripOrHq.title: Boostergang Connections
gripOrHq.rulesText: Trash your hand. Search your stack for as many cards as were successfully trashed in this way and bring them into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterward.

heapOrArchives.title: Meat Upgrade
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Remove up to two tags, at no cost, and draw three cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Running Interference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. During that run, the Corp must pay [X], in addition to the normal cost, to rez each piece of ice, where X is the rez cost of that piece of ice. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Networking
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [9]. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Rent-I-Con
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

scoreArea.title: Please Don't Choke Anyone
scoreArea.rulesText: For each 1 damage you successfully do, you may choose instead to prevent that damage and put a PDCA counter on Please Don't Choke Anyone. PDCA counter: Gain an action. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.

scoreArea.title: Project Venice
scoreArea.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

rig.title: Schematics Search Engine
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, expose all of the Corp's installed cards.

rig.title: Zetatech Portastation
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Zetatech Portastation when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for playing preps. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.

ice.title: Chihuahua
ice.rulesText: *Trace 1-If trace is successful, do 1 Net damage. Gain [2] when you rez Chihuahua.

ice.title: Caryatid
ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Caryatid, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a code gate instead of a wall.

ice.title: Galatea
ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Galatea, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a code gate instead of a wall.

root.title: Emergency Rig
root.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put X Kludge counters on that piece of ice; X cannot be 0. At the start of each of your turns, remove a Kludge counter. Trash that piece of ice when the last Kludge counter is removed from it.

ice.title: Dog Pile
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Dog Pile. *End the run. Dog Pile has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.
